items.h: Questionable for Week 11
items.s: Mayfield (foot/thumb) is officially listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Detroit. Mayfield came out of the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye with a foot injury that sidelined him at Wednesday's practice. He proceeded to be a limited participant Thursday and Friday, and after the latter session, head coach Todd Bowles told Scott Smith of the team's official site that Mayfield "looked good" and is trending toward starting Sunday. Ultimately, Mayfield's status for Week 11 will be confirmed about 90 minutes before a 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff.

items.h: Trending toward Sunday start
items.s: Mayfield (foot) is trending in the right direction to start Sunday's game against the Lions after looking good in Friday's practice, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports. With Mayfield back on the field again Friday after managing the foot issue earlier this week, Tampa Bay appears to be gaining optimism about its starting quarterback's availability for Sunday's matchup. His official game designation for Sunday still will be key, but coach Todd Bowles' comments point toward Mayfield having a chance to avoid another absence.

items.h: Practicing again Friday
items.s: Mayfield (foot) is practicing again Friday, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports. With Mayfield having progressed from sitting out Wednesday to being limited Thursday, Friday's participation is another positive sign for his availability Sunday against Detroit. The Buccaneers' upcoming injury report is destined to reveal both Mayfield's participation level Friday, as well as his Week 11 game status.

items.h: Baker Mayfield Officially Questionable to Play in Week 11
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot) is officially questionable to play in his team's Week 11 matchup against the Detroit Lions, per Greg Auman of Fox Sports. Mayfield is battling a foot sprain that held him out of practice on Wednesday, but he was able to log limited practices on both Thursday and Friday. It's been an injury-marred 2026 season for the 31-year-old, who missed time earlier in the year with a thumb injury. Across six games, Mayfield has thrown for just 922 yards, three touchdowns, and four interceptions. Still, if Mayfield is inactive against Detroit, his absence could be problematic for Tampa Bay's pass-catchers. In that scenario, the Bucs would turn to…

items.h: Baker Mayfield Offers QB2 Value for Week 11 if he Plays
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot) is trending in the right direction ahead of the Week 11 matchup against the Detroit Lions. Mayfield missed practice to begin the week, but has been able to get through two straight practice sessions ahead of Sunday's contest. Mayfield is hopeful for better results after throwing for 243 yards with zero touchdowns and two interceptions in the loss to the Chicago Bears. He draws a favorable matchup against the Detroit Lions defense, which ranks 28th in the league in pass defense. They've allowed nearly 250 passing yards per game and 19 touchdowns coming into this game. RotoBaller has Mayfield ranked as the QB19 for this week. Fantasy…

items.h: Baker Mayfield (foot) trending toward playing in Week 11
items.s: Baker Mayfield (foot) is trending toward playing in Sunday's game against the Lions. Mayfield is dealing with a foot injury that kept him out of practice Wednesday, but the Tampa QB returned to the field in a limited capacity Thursday and is reportedly expected to give it a go Sunday. Mayfield's activity will still need to be monitored Friday. Jalon Daniels would be in line to start if Mayfield cannot go.

items.h: Baker Mayfield Practices Friday Ahead of Lions Game
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot, right thumb) went through his usual work in Friday's indoor practice, FOX Sports' Greg Auman reported, ahead of Sunday's road game against the Detroit Lions. Tampa Bay listed Mayfield as limited Thursday after he sat out Wednesday. Mayfield said Thursday that he felt ready to play, and head coach Todd Bowles planned to assess his availability Friday. Mayfield hurt his foot early in the 27-24 Week 9 loss to the Chicago Bears and finished the game, completing 18 of 32 passes for 243 yards and two interceptions. He used a walking boot during Tampa Bay's bye week, according to NFL Network's Mike Garafolo. Rookie Jalon Daniels would start…

items.h: Officially limited Thursday
items.s: Mayfield (foot/right thumb) officially was limited at Thursday's practice. Mayfield came out of the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye with a foot injury, which kept him out of drills Wednesday. After resuming on-field work Thursday, he relayed to Scott Smith of the team's official site that he felt good and was "limited," the latter of which has been confirmed. Per NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano, Mayfield also said, "If I feel like [Jalon Daniels] gives us a better chance to win, I have no shame in admitting that." As a result, it appears as if both Mayfield and Daniels have a chance to be under center for Tampa Bay on Sunday at Detroit.

items.h: Calls himself 'limited' Thursday
items.s: Mayfield (foot/right thumb) said that he felt good but was "limited" at Thursday's practice, and he's hopeful to do more at Friday's session, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports. The Buccaneers are on the heels of their Week 10 bye, but Mayfield himself has a foot injury in tow stemming back to a Week 9 loss in Chicago. In addition to the new issue, he touched on the dislocated thumb that sidelined him in Weeks 4-6, telling Smith that he had to "grind some things out" in his return to action. Mayfield's status for Sunday's contest at Detroit appears to be truly up in the air, but his ability to practice in some capacity Thursday indicates he at least is putting in every…

items.h: Baker Mayfield Limited in Practice on Thursday
items.s: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers are listing quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot) as a limited participant in Thursday's practice, according to Adam Schefter of ESPN. Mayfield returned to the practice field on Thursday after sitting out on Wednesday due to foot strain that he suffered near the end of the Week 9 loss to the Chicago Bears. The Bucs were on their bye last week, but Mayfield still might not be able to play this Sunday against the Detroit Lions. The 31-year-old veteran has already missed time this year due to a dislocated right thumb in what has been a dreadful season to this point. The two-time Pro Bowler (in his first two seasons in Tampa in 2023 and 2024), Mayfield has thrown for 922…

items.h: Baker Mayfield (foot) returns to practice Thursday
items.s: Baker Mayfield was back at practice on Thursday. Mayfield did not practice on Wednesday to begin the week. His status is still up in the air as he battles a calf strain. He'll need to be monitored in practice again on Friday.

items.h: Back at practice Thursday
items.s: Mayfield (foot/thumb) was seen participating in Thursday's practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports. Coming out of the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Mayfield didn't practice Wednesday while receiving more time off to recover from the foot strain he sustained in a Nov. 8 loss to the Bears. The extent of Mayfield's involvement in Thursday's session won't be known until after it concludes, but the signal-caller was seen participating in ball-security drills and looked to be moving around well. So long as Mayfield steers clear of any setbacks over the next few days, he could be ready to start Sunday's game in Detroit.

items.h: Baker Mayfield Back at Practice on Thursday
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot) is back at practice on Thursday and was even seen doing some hopping through ball-security drills in the portion open to the media, according to Greg Auman of FOX Sports. It is a big step toward Mayfield potentially playing on Sunday against the Detroit Lions. Mayfield reportedly suffered a foot strain near the end of the team's Week 9 loss to the Chicago Bears, and even with the benefit of the bye last week, the 31-year-old veteran signal-caller is questionable to play this weekend in Motown. Earlier this week, the Bucs were not confident that Mayfield would play, setting up Jalon Daniels to potentially make his fourth start of the…

items.h: Baker Mayfield (foot) misses practice Wednesday
items.s: Baker Mayfield did not practice on Wednesday. Mayfield entered the week dealing with a foot strain. His status remains up in the air heading into Week 11.

items.h: Week 11 status TBD
items.s: Coach Todd Bowles said Wednesday that Mayfield (foot), who didn't practice Wednesday, is "a lot better" than he was a week ago, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports. With regard to the QB's availability coming of the team's bye week, Bowles said the plan is to see what Mayfield can do Thursday and then determine his status for Sunday's game against the Lions on Friday. If there is indeed clarity on that front by then, fantasy managers will benefit by avoiding the need to track Tampa Bay's signal-caller situation up to game time. In the event that Mayfield is sidelined this weekend, Jalon Daniels -- who took starter reps Wednesday -- would be in line to start versus Detroit.

items.h: Not practicing Wednesday
items.s: Mayfield (foot) isn't practicing Wednesday, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports. It's not a great sign that coming off the Buccaneers' bye week, Mayfield was at Wednesday's session in street clothes, per Auman, albeit with no wrap or boot on his injured foot. In any case, at this stage, Mayfield is looking iffy for Sunday's game against the Lions, and if he's unavailable for Week 11 action, Jalon Daniels -- who was getting starter reps in drills Wednesday -- would be in line to handle QB1 duties for Tampa Bay this weekend.

items.h: Looking unlikely for Week 11
items.s: The Buccaneers aren't ruling Mayfield (foot) out from playing in Sunday's game at Detroit, but the team views the quarterback as "probably a long shot for this week," Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports. Though head coach Todd Bowles has yet to comment on Mayfield's status for Week 11, media reports over the last few days have pointed toward the veteran quarterback missing his fourth game of the season after he sustained a foot strain late in a Nov. 8 loss to the Bears that resulted in him being in and out of a walking boot during the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye. Fowler acknowledges that Mayfield will likely "push to get ready and play" Sunday, but the Buccaneers may be motivated to hold him out…

items.h: Baker Mayfield Making Progress, Decision to Come in Next 48 Hours
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot), who has been dealing with a foot sprain that has had him in and out of a walking boot, has "made a lot of progress," according to head coach Todd Bowles, and the team will see how he responds to a week of practice before deciding on his Week 11 status. Coming out of a Week 10 bye, the early indication was that Mayfield would be unavailable, but Bowles' Wednesday press conference provided at least a glimmer of optimism. In three games missed earlier this season with a thumb injury, undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels led the Buccaneers to a 1-2 record while throwing for 167 yards per game. A banged-up and inefficient Mayfield has made the…

items.h: Baker Mayfield Not Participating in Practice on Wednesday
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot) is watching practice on Wednesday and is not participating, according to Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times. The Buccaneers are not confident that Mayfield will be able to play in Week 11 on the road against the Detroit Lions, despite having last week's bye to rest a strained foot that he suffered late in the Week 9 loss to the Chicago Bears. The 31-year-old veteran still has two more days to make progress with his foot, but at this time, fantasy managers should not be expecting to have Mayfield available as a QB2 option in two-QB superflex formats. If Mayfield is eventually ruled out for Week 11 action, Jalon Daniels would be in line…

items.h: Baker Mayfield (foot) uncertain for Week 11
items.s: Baker Mayfield is uncertain for Week 11 as he deals with a foot strain. Mayfield will need to be monitored in practice this week. If he sits, Jalon Daniels would start on Sunday against the Lions.

items.h: 'Trending' toward sitting Week 11
items.s: Mayfield (foot) "seems to be trending" toward sitting out Sunday's game against the Lions, with Jalon Daniels likely to draw the Week 11 start, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Coming out of a Week 10 bye, the Buccaneers have yet to provide official word on the status of Mayfield, whom Rapoport relays sustained a foot strain late in a Nov. 8 loss to the Bears that had relegated him to a walking boot over the past week. Given that Mayfield has shown a willingness to playing through injuries in the past, the Buccaneers will likely wait and see how he progresses as the week rolls along before making a decision on his status for Sunday, but Daniels looks like the early favorite to direct…

items.h: Baker Mayfield "Seems" to be Trending Towards Sitting in Week 11
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot) is dealing with a strained foot, and the NFL Network's Ian Rapoport says that from everything he is hearing, it "seems" like Mayfield is trending towards being inactive in Week 11 this Sunday against the Detroit Lions on the road. That would put rookie QB Jalon Daniels in line to make his fourth NFL start after already filling in for three games for Mayfield earlier this year when Mayfield suffered a dislocated thumb on his throwing hand. However, Rapoport also is not completely ruling out Mayfield from toughing it out and playing this weekend, so fantasy managers should consider him truly questionable as of right now. We should have a…

items.h: May be trending toward sitting Week 11
items.s: The Buccaneers appear to be preparing for the possibility of Mayfield (foot) being sidelined for Sunday's game against the Lions, after the team signed Cooper Rush to the practice squad and signed Easton Stick to the 53-man roster Monday, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports. Mayfield sustained a foot sprain when he was sacked during the fourth quarter of the Buccaneers' Week 9 loss to the Bears, and he doesn't appear to have made a full recovery from the injury coming out of a Week 10 bye. After Mayfield was reportedly in and out of a walking boot throughout the bye week, the Buccaneers opted to make a couple of transactions Monday to stabilize their quarterback room. The Buccaneers…

items.h: Baker Mayfield's Foot Injury Limits His Week 11 Waiver Appeal
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot, ankle) used a walking boot during the Week 10 bye after getting hurt against the Chicago Bears, NFL Network's Mike Garafolo reported Sunday. Garafolo said any absence would likely be brief, with Mayfield's status uncertain for Sunday's game at Detroit. Tampa Bay promoted Easton Stick to the active roster and signed Cooper Rush to the practice squad on Monday. Jalon Daniels started three games while Mayfield recovered from a dislocated right thumb earlier this season and would start again if Mayfield sits. Rostered in 21% of Yahoo leagues, Mayfield is a bench add in 14-team, single-quarterback leagues for managers with a Week 11…

items.h: Buccaneers Not Confident Baker Mayfield Will Play in Week 11
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot) may not be ready to play in Week 11, according to the latest report from Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times. Mayfield is dealing with an unspecified injury to his ankle or foot area that he originally picked up against the Bears in Week 9. He played through the issue but has been in and out of a walking boot since that game and seems uncertain for Week 11. The Bucs will be returning from a Week 10 bye as they head to Detroit to face the Lions, who are coming off a big win in Germany over the Patriots. Even the extra time from the bye may not be enough for Mayfield to return, so the Bucs added Cooper Rush to their practice squad on…

items.h: Baker Mayfield Dealing With a Foot Sprain, Questionable in Week 11
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot) suffered a foot sprain and has been in and out of a walking boot, according to the Tampa Bay Times' Rick Stroud. Stroud also said Mayfield's status is in doubt for Week 8's matchup against the Detroit Lions. Mayfield suffered a thumb injury in Week 3 that cost the Buccaneers' starting quarterback three games. Since his return, Mayfield has completed just 25 of 46 passes for 307 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions over the last three games. If the veteran quarterback is unable to play in Week 11, undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels would be set to return to the lineup. Daniels started in three games, completing 60 of 95 attempts for…

items.h: Managing injury to foot/ankle area
items.s: Mayfield's availability for next Sunday's game against the Lions is in question due to an injury he sustained to his foot and ankle area during the Buccaneers' Week 9 loss to the Bears, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports. While Tampa Bay has been on bye for Week 10, Mayfield has been in and out of a walking boot in recent days in an attempt to rehab the injury, per Garafolo. Though the injury isn't viewed as a long-term concern and a stint on injured reserve isn't in consideration, Mayfield could still be at risk of missing his fourth game of the season in Week 11, after he was sidelined from Weeks 4 through 6 due to a dislocated right thumb. Mayfield has struggled since returning from…

items.h: Lower-Leg Injury Clouds Baker Mayfield's Week 11 Status
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (lower leg) was injured against the Chicago Bears in Week 9, and his availability for the Week 11 game against the Detroit Lions on Nov. 22 is uncertain, according to NFL Network's Mike Garafolo. Tampa Bay is on its Week 10 bye. Mayfield was still on the field for Tampa Bay's final offensive play in Chicago, running in the game-tying two-point conversion with 2:51 left. He completed 18 of 32 passes for a season-high 243 yards, with two interceptions and no touchdown passes in the 27-24 loss. It was his third game back from the dislocated right thumb that sidelined him for three games in October. Jalon Daniels started each of those games and…

items.h: Baker Mayfield quiet in Week 9 loss
items.s: Baker Mayfield completed 18 of his 32 passes for 232 yards and two interceptions in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9. He also ran for a two-point conversion in the game. Mayfield threw for a season-high 243 yards but he failed to throw a touchdown for the second straight game. One of his interceptions was returned 67 yards for a touchdown by Jalon Johnson in the third quarter. Mayfield has thrown for 922 yards, three touchdowns, and four interceptions in six games this season. He will be on bye in Week 10 before a Week 11 matchup against the Lions.

items.h: Season-high 243 yards but two INTs
items.s: Mayfield completed 18 of 32 passes for 243 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears. He also rushed once for no gain and ran in a two-point conversion. Mayfield notched a season high in passing yards after finishing Tampa Bay's previous game without a completed pass, but he also threw multiple interceptions for the first time in six starts this season. He put forth a gutsy performance, getting back up from several big hits and scoring the game-tying two-point conversion with his legs to cap Tampa Bay's final drive, only for Chicago to kick a game-winning field goal on the ensuing possession. The struggling QB has taken a back seat to the Buccaneers'…

Baker Mayfield Unable to Salvage Any Touchdowns in Week 9
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield completed 18 of his 32 pass attempts for 243 yards, zero touchdowns, and two interceptions during Sunday's Week 9 loss against the Chicago Bears. The 31-year-old has been an incredibly disappointing fantasy option ever since he returned from injury in Week 7. Across his three games since returning, Mayfield has yet to post double-digit fantasy points in a single game, and he has just 307 yards and one touchdown during that span. Low passing volume and turnovers have been a major red flag for the former No. 1 pick this year, making him a riskier fantasy option when the Bucs return from their Week 10 bye. items.h: Baker Mayfield is Shaky Streaming Option for Week 9
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is coming off one of the oddest stat lines you'll ever see from a starting quarterback. Last week, Mayfield was 0-for-3 on passing attempts with zero touchdowns and zero interceptions in the win over the Atlanta Falcons. The rainy conditions and Mayfield's thumb injury likely played a factor in the Bucs' offensive scheme last week. The week before that, Mayfield only threw for 64 yards in the win over the Carolina Panthers. It's unclear if the Bucs are purposely not passing because of Mayfield's thumb issue or they just haven't needed to because the running game has been so good. We'll see if Mayfield can rebound this weekend against the…

items.h: Baker Mayfield is a Desperation Streaming Option at QB
items.s: In a 16-0 win over the Atlanta Falcons in Week 8, Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield had one of the most bizarre stat lines you will see from a starting signal-caller in the NFL. Mayfield did not complete a single pass, and he only had three passing attempts against the Falcons. It marked the first time since 1974 that a team won a game without completing a single pass. Of course, the heavy rain conditions and sloppy field played a big part in the Bucs not being able to throw the ball. Mayfield did add four rushes for 14 yards, and the Buccaneers leaned on Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell in the ground game to defeat the Falcons. The odds of Mayfield having another game like…

items.h: Baker Mayfield does not complete pass Sunday
items.s: Baker Mayfield went 0-for-3 in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons. The Bucs managed to win a game where Mayfield did not complete a single pass as they ran for 324 yards as a team. This was the second time a team has completed zero passes in the Super Bowl era and the first time in over 50 years. Mayfield will be a QB2 play next week against the Bears.

items.h: Makes ignominious history in win
items.s: Mayfield failed to complete any of his three pass attempts in the Buccaneers' 16-0 win over the Falcons on Sunday. He also rushed four times for 14 yards. The afternoon-long rainy conditions in Tampa Bay and the Falcons' defense's complete inability to slow down the Buccaneers' ground attack led to Mayfield barely putting in any work as a passer. In the process, the Bucs became the first team since 1974 to win a game without a single completion, and the bizarre circumstances left Mayfield's fantasy managers with a dead spot in their lineups. Mayfield will naturally be a lot busier when he travels to the Windy City to face the Bears' aggressive defense in a Week 9 road showdown next Sunday…

items.h: Baker Mayfield Doesn't Complete a Single Pass in Week 8 Win
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield completed zero passes on three attempts in a 16-0 win against the Atlanta Falcons in Week 8. Josh Dubow of the Associated Press reported it was the first time since 1974 that a quarterback completed zero passes in a victory. Tampa Bay running back Bucky Irving scored the team's only touchdown on the day, with kicker Chase McLaughlin adding the remaining points to the scoreboard. Mayfield has now completed just seven passes for 64 yards with one touchdown in two games after he was sidelined in Weeks 4, 5, and 6 with a thumb injury. There was lingering concern that the thumb was still an issue, and now fantasy managers should be wary of playing…

items.h: Baker Mayfield Offers QB2 Value for Week 8
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is hopeful for better results this weekend after struggling to move the ball through the air last week. In Week 7, Mayfield completed 7-of-11 passing attempts for 64 passing yards with one touchdown and zero interceptions in the win over the Carolina Panthers. Mayfield wore a protective glove on his throwing hand, which might've impacted the Bucs offensive gameplan. The Bucs were dominating on the ground, so they didn't ask Mayfield to do much. The hope is that Mayfield will do more damage through the air against the Atlanta Falcons this weekend. A defense that ranks 29th against the pass this season. They've allowed an average of 255.6…

items.h: Still wearing glove on throwing hand
items.s: Mayfield, who was a full practice participant Wednesday, said that he's still taking a day-by-day approach when it comes to wearing a glove to protect his dislocated right thumb, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports. Mayfield returned to action in Week 7 after a three-game absence but wasn't asked to do much in a 43-13 win over the Panthers, as he attempted just 11 passes while the Buccaneers relied heavily on the running game. He wore a protective glove on his throwing hand Sunday, and Mayfield looks like he'll continue to do so again Week 8 versus the Falcons. Given how last week played out, the Buccaneers may continue to favor a run-first attack, even though Atlanta's…

items.s: Baker Mayfield was a full participant in practice on Wednesday. Mayfield made his return this past week for the Bucs. He'll remain a QB2 for fantasy managers.

items.h: Baker Mayfield a Streaming Option After a Quiet Return
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield attempted only 11 passes in the team's Week 7 blowout win over the Panthers. With the Buccaneers getting points out of the defense and the run game clicking on all cylinders, little was asked of the veteran quarterback in his first game back from a two-game absence, but in what should be a more competitive matchup with the Atlanta Falcons, fresh off an upset win over the 49ers, Mayfield has some appeal as a Week 8 streaming option. Atlanta ranks as the 14th-best matchup for fantasy quarterbacks, and with four more teams on bye, Mayfield offers enough of a usable floor to make him RotoBaller's QB19 on the week.

items.h: Baker Mayfield throws 11 passes in return
items.s: Baker Mayfield completed 7-of-11 passes for 64 yards and a touchdown in the Bucs' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday. He also ran once for a yard. Mayfield didn't really do much in his return to play, but he did enough to at least manage things while the running game took over against the Panthers' defense. He will almost assuredly put up stronger numbers against the Falcons next Sunday.

items.h: Extremely light workload in return
items.s: Mayfield completed seven of 11 passes for 64 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions and rushed once for one yard in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday. Making his return from a three-game absence due to a thumb injury, Mayfield had the luxury of being eased back in thanks to a highly positive game script. Tampa Bay already held a 33-6 lead by halftime, which Mayfield contributed to by tossing a 14-yard touchdown pass to Tez Johnson with four seconds remaining in the first half. Mayfield didn't have to do much else during a cakewalk of a second half as well, but it did allow him to work off some rust ahead of a Week 8 home divisional clash against the Falcons next…

items.h: Baker Mayfield Delivers Fantasy Bust Despite Buccaneers' 43-Point Outburst
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield was a fantasy bust in his return from a three-game absence, finishing with just 6.7 fantasy points in Sunday's 43-13 victory over the Carolina Panthers with little opportunity to accumulate production. Mayfield completed seven of 11 passes for 64 yards and one touchdown without an interception, added one rushing yard, and posted an efficient 109.7 passer rating. His lone touchdown, a 14-yard connection with Tez Johnson late in the second quarter, gave Tampa Bay a commanding 33-6 halftime advantage. The Buccaneers attempted 49 rushes for 258 yards and three touchdowns, while their defense contributed another score on a fumble return. Head…

items.s: Mayfield (thumb) is active for Sunday's game against the Panthers. Following a three-game absence, Mayfield returned to practice this week as a full participant from Wednesday through Friday. Tampa Bay still elected to list him as questionable heading into Sunday, but Mayfield's availability was never in any peril after he experienced no setbacks with his dislocated right thumb throughout the week. Though he'll be back under center for the first time since Week 3, Mayfield will be wearing a specialized glove on his right hand that offers added support to the injured joint in his thumb, per Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site. Mayfield will be returning to the lineup without his…

items.h: Baker Mayfield to Wear Protective Glove Against Panthers
items.s: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (right thumb) profiles as a Week 7 QB2 whose greatest fantasy appeal comes in Superflex and deeper leagues, and he will wear a custom protective glove for Sunday's matchup against the Carolina Panthers. NFL Network's Ian Rapoport shared a photo of the custom equipment ahead of kickoff. Developed with assistance from the Tampa Bay Rays, the glove features reinforcement behind Mayfield's dislocated thumb to prevent it from bending backward. Mayfield acknowledged that wearing the glove requires adjustments to his grip and release point but said he feels comfortable throwing with the glove on. The veteran practiced in full throughout Week 7, and…

items.h: Officially listed questionable for Week 7
items.s: Mayfield (thumb) was a full participant in Friday's practice but is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Panthers, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports. Coach Todd Bowles already told Greg Auman of Fox Sports earlier Friday that Mayfield is good to go for Week 7, so it would be a shock if the veteran quarterback isn't under center Sunday. It will be Mayfield's first action since Week 3 against the Vikings. Jalon Daniels will head back to QB2 duties once Mayfield is officially cleared.

items.h: Cleared to return Sunday
items.s: Head coach Todd Bowles said Friday that Mayfield (right thumb) is ready for Sunday's game at Carolina, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports. After missing Tampa Bay's last three games with a dislocated right thumb, Mayfield is expected to return to action against a Carolina team that's 2.5 games ahead of Tampa Bay in the NFC South standings. With wideout Emeka Egbuka (concussion/toe) listed as doubtful, Mayfield will likely look to Chris Godwin, Ted Hurst and Tez Johnson as his top targets at wide receiver.

items.h: Mayfield (right thumb) practiced fully Thursday.
items.s: This marks a second straight uninhibited practice for Mayfield as he seeks his first game action since Week 3 due to a dislocated right thumb. Per Greg Auman of Fox Sports, Mayfield again was wearing a glove on his right hand Thursday, and afterward the quarterback told Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site that he "feels fine gripping and throwing," with the biggest concern enduring hits and taking the ball under center. Head coach Todd Bowles has yet to announce a Week 7 starter between Mayfield and undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels, but that'll likely occur Friday ahead of Sunday's…

items.h: Mayfield (thumb) was seen participating in Wednesday's practice and was throwing while wearing a glove on his right hand, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.
items.s: Just as head coach Todd Bowles suggested would be the case Monday, Mayfield was able to get back on the field for the Buccaneers' first day of Week 7 prep in what marked the veteran quarterback's first appearance in practice since dislocating his right thumb Sept. 27. Per Jenna Laine of ESPN.com, the Buccaneers are preparing for undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels to make a fourth straight start this Sunday at Carolina, but Mayfield could change those plans if he shows that he can grip the football securely and throw without any major hindrance during the team's practices this week. The…

items.h: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said that Mayfield (thumb) is "supposed to practice" Wednesday, Brianna Dix of the team's official site reports.
items.s: Mayfield hasn't logged any practice activity and has missed three consecutive games since dislocating his right thumb in a Sept. 27 loss to the Vikings, but he looks poised to take a meaningful step forward in his recovery process during the upcoming week. According to Greg Auman of Fox Sports, Bowles added that while he's still planning for undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels to make a fourth straight start this coming Sunday against the Panthers, the Buccaneers will evaluate how Mayfield looks with his throwing over the next few days before making any decisions. Shortly after Mayfield was…

items.h: Mayfield (thumb) will not play Sunday, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.
items.s: Head coach Todd Bowles confirmed what had been made obvious by Mayfield's continued absence from practices. There hasn't been anything said about his Week 7 chances, but the fact that it wasn't even a close call for Week 6 isn't the best sign. Jalon Daniels will make another start Sunday against Pittsburgh.

items.h: Buccaneers offensive coordinator Zac Robinson said Thursday that Mayfield's right thumb is "just not quite ready" this week, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.
items.s: Mayfield officially hasn't practiced so far this week due to the dislocated right thumb that he sustained back in Week 3 against the Vikings, but head coach Todd Bowles told Greg Auman of Fox Sports that the quarterback was slated to attempt throwing Wednesday. Clearly, Mayfield is making progress away from the practice field, but until he mixes into drills in some capacity, he'll continue to cede starts to undrafted rookie signal-caller Jalon Daniels on game days.

items.h: Mayfield (thumb) wasn't spotted at practice Thursday, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.
items.s: Mayfield has yet to practice or play since sustaining a thumb injury late in Tampa Bay's Week 3 loss to the Vikings. He looks to be headed for a third consecutive absence Sunday against the Steelers, which would pave the way for Jalon Daniels to remain in the starting role under center. Daniels guided the Buccaneers to a win over Dallas in Week 5 after losing to the Packers in Week 4.

items.h: Mayfield (right thumb) officially didn't practice Wednesday.
items.s: However, head coach Todd Bowles said that Mayfield will attempt to throw Wednesday afternoon as he progresses in his recovery from a dislocated right thumb, per Greg Auman of Fox Sports. It remains unclear if Mayfield will be able to mix into any drills Thursday and/or Friday, but if he does, it'll mark his first on-field activity since initially suffering the injury in Week 3 against the Vikings. In Mayfield's stead, undrafted rookie QB Jalon Daniels has directed to Buccaneers to a 1-1 record.

items.h: Mayfield (thumb) wasn't spotted on the field for Wednesday's practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.
items.s: After recently transitioning into a smaller splint for his dislocated right thumb, Mayfield is expected to test his ability to grip and throw the football this week, per Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times. However, Mayfield looks like he'll wait until at least Thursday to get back on the field, with his ongoing absence from practice likely setting the stage for undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels to make a third straight start this weekend against the Steelers.

items.h: Mayfield (thumb) "might do some stuff in practice this week" but appears unlikely to play Sunday against the Steelers, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
items.s: After dislocating his right thumb late in a Sept. 27 loss to the Vikings, Mayfield was given a rough recovery timeline of 3-to-6 weeks. The veteran quarterback recently transitioned to a smaller splint for his thumb, which the Buccaneers hope will allow him to resume gripping and throwing the football this week. While Mayfield might have an outside chance at suiting up Sunday if he ends up returning to practice within the next day or two and is able to throw without any limitations, undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels still appears to be trending toward a third consecutive start at this stage of…

items.h: Head coach Todd Bowles said Friday that Mayfield (thumb) now is in a smaller splint, and the Bucs will see if he can progress to gripping the football next week, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.
items.s: Bowles admitted the "plan" is for Jalon Daniels to start next Sunday against the Steelers after the rookie quarterback helped lead the Bucs to their first victory of the season in a stunning upset of the Cowboys on Thursday night. Mayfield has missed two games and initially was given a recovery timetable of 3-to-6 weeks, so he appears to be progressing normally with his dislocated right thumb.

items.h: Mayfield's dislocated right thumb could keep him out anywhere from 3-to-6 weeks, depending on how quickly he's able to resume gripping the football without issue, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
items.s: Head coach Todd Bowles previously acknowledged that Mayfield would miss at least three weeks due to the injury, which he sustained in last Sunday's loss to the Vikings. Though Mayfield was cleared of any tendon or ligament damage and won't need surgery on the thumb on his throwing hand, the two-time Pro Bowler required stitches to close a wound caused by the dislocation. Despite facing a loose recovery timeline that could keep him out for more than four games, Mayfield avoided placement on injured reserve Saturday, which signals that the Buccaneers are still holding out hope that he might be…

items.h: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that Mayfield (thumb) is expected to miss three weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
items.s: Earlier Monday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reported than an MRI on Mayfield's dislocated right thumb ruled out a fracture as well as any tendon or ligament damage. While Mayfield appears set to avoid surgery, he'll still need some time off to regain strength in his thumb so that he can properly grip the football and throw accurately and at full velocity. Per Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network, Bowles said that Mayfield won't be placed on injured reserve, so the Buccaneers could be targeting their Week 10 game in Carolina for his return to the lineup. Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels will step in as…

items.h: Mayfield underwent an MRI on his dislocated right thumb Monday that revealed no fracture, tendon or ligament damage, but the quarterback is still expected to miss time, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Mayfield is scheduled to get a second opinion on his thumb, so the Buccaneers may not provide a formal timeline for his recovery until he meets with another specialist. That being said, the dislocated thumb on his throwing hand will inhibit Mayfield's ability to grip the football, so the Buccaneers are expected to hold him out for at least their Week 4 game. Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels came on in relief of Mayfield late in Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings and looks on track to make his first NFL start this weekend at home against the Packers.

items.h: Week 3 winners and losers: Gibbs and JSN stay hot; St. Brown and Taylor go quiet
items.s: Jahmyr Gibbs and Jaxon Smith-Njigba came up big in Week 3, while Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jonathan Taylor had very quiet days.

items.h: Mayfield is dealing with a dislocated right thumb and will have an MRI on the injury, head coach Todd Bowles relayed after Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.
items.s: Mayfield exited Sunday's loss late in the fourth quarter after sustaining the thumb injury to his throwing hand. Jalon Daniels played Tampa Bay's final possession after Mayfield got hurt. The undrafted rookie backup failed to complete a pass and threw an interception on the game's final play. A recovery timeline for Mayfield likely will be established based on the results of his upcoming MRI, but Daniels may get a chance to make his first NFL start when the 0-3 Buccaneers host the 1-2 Packers in Week 4.

items.h: Mayfield left the field accompanied by training staff in the fourth quarter of Sunday's game against the Vikings after sustaining an apparent hand injury, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.
items.s: To add insult to injury, Mayfield was intercepted on a fourth-down pass in a one-possession game in the fourth quarter on the play during which he sustained the injury. He stayed down after the play and eventually got up holding his right thumb. Rookie backup Jalon Daniels replaced Mayfield on the following drive, per Greg Auman of Fox Sports. Mayfield threw for 217 yards, one touchdown and one interception while adding six rushing yards prior to the injury.

items.h: Mayfield completed 21 of 34 passes for 182 yards with one touchdown and one interception while adding four rushes for 29 yards in the Buccaneers' 23-19 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
items.s: There had been buzz surrounding Mayfield's matchup against the team that drafted him first overall in 2018, but the veteran signal-caller couldn't deliver a revenge victory. Mayfield looked surprisingly out of sorts most of the afternoon against a Browns defense that had been dominated by the Jaguars in Week 1, and after an extensive weather delay, he went just 1-for-4 for six yards once play resumed at the two-minute warning with the Buccaneers at Cleveland's 28-yard line and needing a touchdown. Mayfield added another turnover on his late first-quarter interception as well, putting him…
